name: emailblackhole-cypress-starter
description: Cypress starter: test the email your app sends (password reset, sign-up confirmation, magic link) with Email Blackhole. No signup, no API key.

scripts.test: concurrently --kill-others --success first --names app,cypress "npm start" "wait-on -t 30000 http-get://localhost:3000/forgot-password && cypress run"
scripts.demo: concurrently --kill-others --names app,cypress "npm start" "wait-on -t 30000 http-get://localhost:3000/forgot-password && cypress open"
